selection: One pair per board; no port, >=8 local pips, equal total pips, sheep pips, hex count, local/combined resource count; OW-minus-WB contrast gap >=6, hence >=3 pips shifted from wood/brick to ore/wheat. Max total pips then contrast, vertex ties. No network scores used to select pairs.
policy: Both seats frozen Generation37, greedy legal policy, no search/no noise/no resignation; 500-turn cap. Common initial RNG state within each board pair; different boards have distinct seeded streams. Later draws/steals can desynchronize the streams.
patch_meaning: At first A Play choice, only if same turn and at least two common legal actions, replace whole global vector of WB target with OW donor at each boundary. Directional projection onto centered donor-minus-target legal logits. Not percentage of a concept or proof of a plan; patch is a hybrid activation state.

units.counts: Building/buying actions by A through global turn40, excluding setup; roads include development-card roads. any is fraction with at least one such action.

caveats: Matched exact total production, sheep production, local resource count, total resource coverage and adjacent hex count; geometry, numbers, immediate cards and roads can differ.
Selected forced alternative openings, not representative of usual greedy openings; no claim that one strategy wins more in general.
One rollout per condition per independent board; paired intervals measure sampling uncertainty across these boards, not model or specification uncertainty.
Counts have four primary outcomes; CIs are pointwise, exploratory. No tuning after seeing rollout outcomes.
